originalGeneration.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create the BODYWEIGHT SQUAT standing master by editing the supplied canonical goblet-squat reference. KEEP EXACTLY the same head, face, torso, hips, legs, stance, shoes, scale, camera, crop, black background, anatomical style, purple quadriceps, lilac gluteals, pale trunk. Remove the dumbbell completely and change ONLY the arm pose: extend both arms forward at shoulder height for counterbalance, parallel to each other, soft elbows, palms down with relaxed straight fingers. Do not spread arms sideways. Both hands fully inside canvas, avoid obscuring the face. Body remains upright, feet planted shoulder-width and toes slightly out, same white low-top shoes. Preserve the exact white/light-grey anatomical athlete proportions and fine dark contour lines. This is frame1 of six: upright / small descent / near-parallel / bottom / middle rise / late rise. Show only upright here. No equipment, no text, no labels, one separate native1024x1536 image.

Edit this exact BODYWEIGHT SQUAT standing master into frame2 SMALL INITIAL DESCENT. Same canvas camera zoom anatomy proportions and muscle colours. Keep both complete shoes pixel-aligned in their exact current positions; soles never leave the ground. Bend hips and knees slightly together, lower hips and head by only about100pixels, small knee flexion roughly30degrees, thighs still much closer to vertical than horizontal. Hips travel slightly backward, knees track toes, chest remains lifted. Both arms remain extended forward at shoulder height relative to the trunk, carried downward with shoulders, hands separate and unchanged in size. Spine neutral, no exaggerated torso lean, no knee collapse. Do not shrink head, torso, thighs or calves; flex joints only. Same bald faceless white anatomical male, white shoes, deep purple quads/lilac glutes/pale trunk. Single native full-resolution portrait image, black background, no text or equipment.

Edit this exact BODYWEIGHT SQUAT early descent into frame3 LOWER, approaching parallel. Preserve same canvas/camera/anatomy scale and white shoes in precisely their fixed floor positions. Bend hips and knees farther to lower head and hips another approximately140pixels. Thighs now slope gently downward from hips toward knees, just above parallel; knees track toes without caving, heels flat. Keep spine neutral and chest lifted, a modest natural forward torso inclination. Both arms stay extended forward approximately horizontal, hands the same size and both fully inside frame. Do not shorten torso, inflate thighs or change head dimensions. Same deep purple quadriceps, lilac gluteals and subtle pale trunk; muscle hierarchy remains fixed. No equipment, text, borders or new scene. One separate native1024x1536 portrait image.

Edit this exact bodyweight squat frame into frame4 BOTTOM. Make only a SMALL further descent: lower the hip crease roughly60pixels so it sits just below knee-top height, with a modestly deeper knee bend. Head and outstretched arms follow this small descent; keep their dimensions and outlines identical. Entire shoes and stance stay exactly registered to the original floor, no shoe movement or heel lift. Thighs reach slightly below parallel, knees aligned with toe direction, natural neutral spine and chest lifted, no lumbar rounding or extreme deep collapse. Both arms stay extended forward, parallel, same palms-down fingers, same lengths. Do not shrink head or torso, enlarge muscles or change highlights. Same white anatomical athlete, white shoes, deep purple quads/lilac glutes, black background. Single native full-resolution portrait frame, no text or equipment.
